**A new interface. Every screen is rebuilt, there is a light and a dark theme, and a command palette reaches everything.**

## New

- **Light and dark themes.** Pick one, or follow Windows. Settings > Appearance, for every vault.
- **Accent color and interface size.** One color for the selection, the main button of each view and the keyboard focus. Size scales text and controls from 75% to 200%, on top of the Windows display scaling.
- **Command palette.** `Ctrl+K`, or the search field in the title bar, finds accounts, screens, actions and settings from anywhere.
- **Keyboard shortcuts.** `Ctrl+1` to `Ctrl+5` switch screens, `Ctrl+N` adds an account, `Ctrl+,` opens Settings, `Ctrl+L` locks the vault, `Ctrl+Shift+P` toggles privacy mode. `Ctrl+/` lists them all.
- **Table view for accounts.** Every account in sortable columns. It takes the place of the card grid; the grouped list with its detail pane is the default.
- **Vault switcher.** The active vault sits at the top of the sidebar in its own color, with the others one click away.
- **Background activity in the sidebar.** A refresh, a CS2 pull, a funds fetch or a clean shows there while it runs, and leaves when it is done.
- **New app icon.**

## Changed

- **Navigation is grouped by what you are doing.** Accounts first, then Steam Guard (Authenticator, Confirmations), then Trading (Trade offers, CS2), with Add account and Settings at the bottom. The status bar is gone: an update shows in the sidebar, results show as toasts.
- **Settings has fifteen categories and a search.** Options that apply at once say so. Everything else waits for Save, as before.
- **Confirmations are harder to approve by accident.** Bulk approve leaves out account recoveries and phone number changes unless you add them, and each of those asks on its own. Deny and every bulk action ask first. A bulk action can span accounts.
- **Accepting a trade that only gives items away asks first.** Sent offers can be confirmed from the offer itself, and auto-confirm can be switched per send.
- **The weekly CS2 drop is claimed in one go.** The button waits until every pick is made, because the game hands out the whole drop at once. Storage unit moves run one item at a time.
- **Adding Steam Guard explains itself first**, and does not finish until you tick that the revocation code is written down somewhere outside the app.
- **The cleaner runs only from a fresh preview**, and not while its settings have unsaved changes.
- **Narrow windows fold the sidebar down to icons.**
- **"Check for updates at launch" moved to Settings > About.**

## Fixed

- **"Create a new vault" on the unlock screen adds a vault.** It used to replace the active one.
- **Two descriptions in Settings were wrong.** The Steam Web API key is kept as plain text in the vault's `settings.json`, not inside the encrypted vault, and trades with trusted partners are never approved automatically. Both texts now say what happens.
- **The bulk size limit for confirmations takes effect.** It was saved and ignored.
- **A relocated data folder is recognised by its `vaults.json`**, not only by a `vault.bin`.
- **The update check and the links in About point at the repository's current address.**

## Notes

- Accounts, vaults and master passwords are untouched, and your settings carry over. If you used the card grid you get the table.
- The app opens in the dark theme. Light and "follow Windows" are in Settings > Appearance.
- Removed with the old interface: the card grid, the Type column in Confirmations, the color coding of the spent amount, and the 1,024 character limit on account notes.

<details>
<summary><b>Housekeeping</b></summary>

- The interface is built on [Facet](https://github.com/velyndev/imgui-facet), a design framework for Dear ImGui, with FreeType for text. Building from source needs CMake 3.28 or newer; the solution builds Facet by itself.
- Debug builds carry a screenshot harness (`--ui-capture`) that renders every screen offscreen with demo data, without touching a vault, Steam or the network.
- The old widget layer is removed.
- README, CONTRIBUTING and SECURITY are rewritten for the new interface. SECURITY lists every file that is stored unencrypted next to the vault, and what is in it.
- The license notices of the bundled libraries ship as `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, in the zip and linked from Settings > About.
- Release notes are published from `.github/release-notes/<tag>.md`.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Requirements and first run</b></summary>

**Requirements.** Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Statically linked, so no Visual C++ redistributable.

**First run.** The binary is unsigned, so SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Code-signing certificates are not free.

**Upgrading.** Accounts, vaults and master passwords are untouched. Replace the exe and start it.

**Privacy.** No telemetry. The app talks to Steam for the features you use, and to GitHub only if you enable the update check.

</details>
